official_access.access_mode: Official Wikimedia pages-articles multistream XML dumps; prefer the partitioned .xml.bz2 files for parallel external acquisition.

snapshot_policy.rule: Pin the enwiki dump date and exact pages-articles-multistream file inventory. Verify each downloaded object against Wikimedia's published checksum and compute a local SHA-256. Derive source_snapshot from a deterministic SHA-256 over the sorted filename, byte length, official checksum and local SHA-256 inventory. A date alone is not the final lake snapshot identity.

license_policy.rule: Preserve a stable oldid URL for every occurrence. Wikimedia text is reusable under the applicable free-license terms, but imported text can carry compatible-license or additional attribution requirements; do not erase page/revision lineage or visible source-specific notices during curated reuse.

adapter.input: One or more official pages-articles-multistream XML, XML.bz2 or XML.gz files
adapter.selection: Main namespace pages by default; every non-empty <math>...</math> body in current revision wikitext
